standard_prerequisites.name: Nonvanishing of a localisation as a support condition
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Used at the end of the counted proof (lines 15343-15344)
standard_prerequisites.use: Turns the class of m being nonzero in the localisation at p into membership of p in the support.

core_obligations: Unwind membership in the associated primes to an element m of M whose annihilator is exactly the prime p, so that no element outside p annihilates m (proof lines 15341-15342).
Therefore the class of m in the localisation at p is nonzero, which is exactly the statement that p lies in the support of M (proof lines 15342-15344).
proof_roadmap: Produce a witness element from the annihilator description of associated primes (proof lines 15340-15342).
Show that witness survives localisation at p, which is membership of p in the support (proof lines 15342-15345).
difficulty_reason: For an R-module M the lemma states that the associated primes of M form a subset of the support of M (statement lines 15334-15338). The proof does not go through primary decomposition or through annihilator ideals of the module as a whole: it takes an element m whose annihilator is the associated prime p, notes that this is exactly the statement that no element outside p annihilates m, and reads the resulting nonvanishing of the localisation as membership in the support (proof lines 15340-15345). Converting the annihilator condition into a localisation statement is the content, and the author writes it out. H2.
